title: Kandev marketplace registry list
description: Schema for plugin-registry/plugins.yaml, the curated pointer list of plugin and canvas repositories. Release metadata is read from the package at index-build time; preview images are registry-owned presentation metadata.

plugins.description: The curated list of plugin repositories, one entry per plugin.

id.description: Stable plugin identifier. MUST equal the plugin manifest `id` of the repo's latest release. Unique across the file.

repo.description: GitHub repository in owner/name form; the release source for this plugin.

featured.description: When true, a maintainer has pinned this entry above star order in the catalog.

categories.description: Curation-only category tags used for filtering in the catalog.

kind.description: Omitted kind means plugin. Canvas entries are validated as portable canvas packages.

previews.description: Ordered listing images. Optional for plugins and required for canvas entries.

url.description: Direct HTTPS listing image URL without credentials or a fragment.

alt.description: Accessible description of the listing image.
